thread:
michelle (PM): Heads-up: Acme and FinSider want stronger guarantees for geo-residency + tenant isolation. They asked for a pilot we can turn on per-customer. Need to decide scope: small, fast pilot vs bigger integrated rollout. Thoughts?
anya (Architect): I suggest piloting a narrow surface: per-tenant routing preference + deterministic fallback chain. Keep storage residency enforcement and model variant fallbacks out of pilot. That reduces infra changes.
sam (Sales): Customers will push on SLAs. If we say 'failover < 300ms' they will take it literally. Can we promise that for cold-cache cases?
raj (SRE): Not without KV warm caches replicated. Cold-cache failover will be heavier. For pilot, promise routing decision latency (i.e., how fast we choose a region) under 300ms, but document cold-KV as a separate metric.
derek (Eng): Implementation plan: lightweight policy evaluator in the request proxy that consults a replicated routing table. PoC: 2 sprints to get evaluator + config API, 1 sprint to wire telemetry.
morgan (Data): We'll need per-tenant cost attribution hooks in the path. Pilot must emit tenant_id + routing_decision + chosen_region for billing and dashboards.
hina (Compliance): For NovaHealth-like customers, private deployment parity is mandatory. Pilot must include a compatibility checklist for VPC/private control plane and KMS mappings.
anya (Architect): Good call. Pilot acceptance criteria (draft):
- routing policy config API + UI toggle for pilot opt-in
- deterministic fallback chain defined and tested
- routing decision trace present in spans and logs
- per-tenant billing tags emitted
- canary at 2-10% traffic with opt-in switching
- documented rollback and emergency cutover plan
- compliance checklist for Private deployment
If any criteria fail during canary, stop rollout.
michelle (PM): Risk list: cross-region bandwidth egress, cost blowouts during cache warmup, complexity in console UX. Prioritize minimal UX surface.
sam (Sales): Customers want an opt-in path that doesn't require SDK changes. A config flag + admin console toggle is necessary.
raj (SRE): Add chaos tests: simulate region pair outage and verify pilot tenants continue to succeed at >95% success (excluding intentionally blocked tenants). Also monitor error budget consumption.
derek (Eng): Out-of-scope for pilot: automatic model fallback, auto-quantization-based cheaper region routing, and tenant-level compute isolation. Those can be Q4 items.
morgan (Data): Data retention and metrics: ensure traces have tenant and request hashes for deduping. We should cap retention for pilot telemetry to 30 days to control costs.
hina (Compliance): For Private customers, include an FAQ mapping how routing controls interact with KMS and audit logs. I can draft.
michelle (PM): Timeline: customers want a pilot offer by end of next quarter. Realistic if we prioritize evaluator + config API and reuse existing replication for routing table. Need owners and tickets.
anya (Architect): Owners: derek -> policy evaluator & config API RFC; raj -> runbooks & chaos tests; morgan -> metrics schema; hina -> compliance doc; sam -> customer opt-in comms.
ops-bot: ticket created: #PRD-1429 - routing-pilot-epic (assigned: derek) :ticket: :white_check_mark:
michelle (PM): Actionables: derek post RFC by Wed, raj to draft chaos scenarios, morgan to send metrics proto, hina to produce Private compatibility checklist, sam to compile pilot customer list for opt-in. Weekly sync Thursday 10am PT. Thanks.
